lines.zh: 我四条腿走路，肚子很低。
lines.en: I walk on four legs, belly low.

lines.zh: 我的颈盾在太阳下反光。
lines.en: My frill catches the sun.
My claws push the gravel aside.
I follow my pack across the red rock.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边啃低矮的草。
lines.en: I graze the low scrub as I walk.
My beak snaps stems.
Hot wind blows sand onto my back.
I pause in the rock's shade.
Slow steps. No hurry.
My young walks beside me.

lines.zh: 颈盾卡了一下，我硬挤过去。
lines.en: My frill catches, but I squeeze through.

lines.zh: 我摇摇晃晃地绕开浅坑。
lines.en: I wobble around the shallow pits.
My tail sways lightly behind.
I lower my head and sniff the sand.

lines.zh: 我趴下来，把腿收在身下。
lines.en: I settle with my legs tucked under.
Badland sand grinds at my beak.
I rub my jaw with a hind leg.
My pack grazes on the slope.

lines.zh: 我的颈盾边沿有点缺损。
lines.en: A chip along my frill.
Wind moans over the rocks.
I close my eyes slowly and open them.
An insect crosses my forefoot.
I lift my head to listen.
The sun heats my frill.
I hone my beak on a stone.
The grass is cropped bare here.
I look for a narrow gap to shelter in.
Too much dust; I shut my eyes.
Do not touch the little one.

lines.zh: 我低下了头，把盾对向你。
lines.en: My head is down; my frill faces you.
You are blocking the wind.
I have a beak, and teeth behind it.
You carry the smell of water.
I step in front of my young.
We do not fight without cause.
That is close enough.
My pack is watching.

lines.zh: 你还不走，我就当你要打。
lines.en: If you don't leave now, I'll take it as a fight.

lines.zh: 我把脚在地上刮了一下。
lines.en: I scrape my foot on the ground.
Do not raise a hand.
I back half a step, head low.
Another chip in my frill.
My breathing is thick and heavy.
My young hides behind me.
I can carry this.
Blood falls on the sand.
My knees give no strength.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，同伴围过来。
lines.en: I call, and the pack gathers.

lines.zh: 恶地的土太松，我站不稳。
lines.en: The badland soil is loose. I cannot brace.
I can still bear it.
Are those young leaves?
Put them down. I come slowly.
This handful isn't enough to share.
These leaves are cloyingly sweet.
I let the young eat first.
I take it and step back.
Not quite so close.
I chew it slowly, bite by bite.
Is there anything else?
Thank you for these.

lines.zh: 我的颈盾被撞得发闷响。
lines.en: My frill takes the hit with a dull thud.
My frill caught you.
You hit hard bone.

lines.zh: 原角龙的短腿，站得很稳。
lines.en: A protoceratops's short legs stand steady.
My young has moved behind me.
I turn aside and yield.
Sand flies up from that.
Both of us are still standing.
Do not force your way in.
The path here is narrow.
We keep to pairs.

lines.zh: 我把头贴在同伴的颈上。
lines.en: I press my head to my mate's neck.
The time is not yet.
The young is right here.
A hum rises in my throat.
Move aside a little.
We do not welcome you.
I turned away.
This is not for you to see.
Please leave.
I cannot chew this.
I hook it over with a claw.
Not grass. Do not offer it.
I kicked it away.
A good stone here.
I shove it along ahead of me.
I push it into the sand.
No use in this.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩上去，东西陷进沙。
lines.en: I step on it and it sinks into the sand.
Leave it here.
My head is down.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，把颈盾横在你面前。
lines.en: I turn sideways and present my frill.
The frill makes me harder.
My beak can snap a stem.

lines.zh: 低头，先撞，再看要不要咬。
lines.en: Head down: ram first, bite later.
My neck is strong.
You chose badly today.
My pack will join.
I will not run.
One step back would settle this.
I drop my head and aim my frill forward.
I am nearly there.
Once more: move.
This is the blow.
I push forward, step by step.
My beak points at your knee.
Your feet slip on the sand.
I move toward my young.
I am not flustered at all.
You retreat, and I stop.
My pack has formed a half circle.
The moment you lift a foot, I charge.
My frill blocks your view.
Still standing, so still fighting.
One more block and I can reach you.
The dust hides us.

lines.zh: 你听见我喉咙里的声了吗？
lines.en: Do you hear my throat?
The young have fallen back behind me.
I drive my neck shield at you.
Let us finish quickly.
I raise my head to charge.
My head meets your calf.
My beak clamps your boot.
That had some weight.
My pack rams from the side.
I shove and you give half a step.
My frill hits your ribs.
I swing my head and knock you off balance.
My teeth slide off your plate.
You kick my frill.
That knock stung.
I ram again.
Sand sprays high.
Your greave dents.
I pull back over my young.
Still coming closer?
Then we continue.

lines.zh: 我们三只从红岩后出来。
lines.en: Three of us come from behind the red rock.
The grass is sparse here.
I raise my frill to look.
I root at the soil with my beak.
The badland sun is fierce.
I turn over some sand.
Our scent is all over this ground.
I walk up the slope.
My pack spreads out to graze.
I hear stones shift.
Something moves among the broken rocks.
We close around the young.
I lower my head for a bite.
We can stay a while.
Who are you?
Not near the little one.
Fire heats my frill.
I hit stone; my frill chips.
Water fills my beak.
I'm flipped onto my back, legs in the air.
An arrow stands in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那光让我的腿不听使唤。
lines.en: That light takes my legs.
Too little grass. I weaken.

lines.zh: 雷打在红岩上，我缩起来。
lines.en: Lightning hits the red rock; I crouch.
No sand here, and no grass.
